title: Speaking God's Word for Breakthrough and Revival
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges listeners to let their words align with God's promises, even in the midst of difficult circumstances, and to declare breakthrough and victory in every area of their lives. Join Pastor Chris as he shares a timely message that will inspire and equip you to stand in faith and speak God's word, regardless of what you see or feel. This message is a call to action, a reminder that God is at work in your life right now, and that you have the power to shape your future by speaking His truth.
